Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Authorised administrator record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when admin access was granted.

User.title: User
User.description: Shared User profile document for ZENRATION PAY Android App and Website.

userId.description: Unique Firebase Auth UID of the user.

name.description: Full display name of the user (shared across Website and Android).

displayName.description: Mirrored display name for Android UI.

email.description: Google account email address of the user.

photoURL.description: Profile avatar URL (shared across Website and Android).

upiId.description: Generated simulated UPI handle for the user (e.g. name@zenpay.sim).

notificationsEnabled.description: Whether simulated payment alerts are enabled.

biometricSimEnabled.description: Whether simulated security shield is enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was created (submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was last updated (submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Balance.title: Balance
Balance.description: Shared demo balance record synchronized in real time between ZENRATION PAY Website and Android App.

userId.description: Unique Firebase Auth UID owning this demo balance.

demoBalance.description: Current simulated demo balance amount (shared canonical field across Website and Android).

isDemo.description: Always true to indicate this balance is strictly a demo simulation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the balance record was initialized (submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the balance was last modified (submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Shared simulated QR/UPI payment transaction record. Strictly labelled SIMULATED – NOT PAID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who initiated the simulated transaction (shared canonical field).

userId.description: Mirrored Firebase Auth UID of the user.

recipientName.description: Display name of the recipient parsed from the UPI QR code.

recipientUPI.description: UPI ID of the recipient parsed from the UPI QR code (shared canonical field).

recipientUpiId.description: Mirrored UPI ID of the recipient.

status.description: Transaction status, strictly constrained to SIMULATED or SIMULATED – NOT PAID.

isSimulated.description: Always true; confirms no real money was transferred.

note.description: Optional note or remarks for the simulated payment.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the simulated payment was recorded (submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Stores authorised administrator UIDs for ZENRATION PAY Admin Website.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores authenticated user profiles keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/balances/{userId}.description: Stores per-user demo balances keyed by Firebase Auth UID, synced in real time between Website and Android App.

/transactions/{transactionId}.description: Stores immutable simulated payment transactions scoped by uid.
